title: Общий журнал и контекстные объяснения доступа
goal: Объяснить текущее и историческое решение без создания второй policy/audit истины.
non_goals: Не переносить все журналы в новую каноническую таблицу без отдельного ADR.
Не интерпретировать произвольный Python policy код.
implementation_notes: Projection normalizes AccessAssignmentAudit, SettingsChange, AgentActionLog and AD sync audit.
Filters: time, actor, target, role, source, risk, result, correlation id.
No universal troubleshooter page is created; contextual Why actions are added only for confirmed support scenarios.
Explicit domain adapters return allow, deny or unknown/incomplete with source and scope.
Technical source owner, provenance and editability are shown inside user/role details.
acceptance_checks: Projection pagination/filtering and no secret/PII leakage.
Object not visible returns safe denial without existence disclosure.
Positive and negative explanations for each supported domain.
Audit correlation from AI pending action to applied domain event.
independent_review: Обязателен privacy/security review объяснений и audit projection.
